text:
emma: Midweek safety check: starting a small release train for hotfix bundle release-2024.05.0-rc1. Canary target: edge-proxy at 5% -> ramp. Freeze window starts Thu 20:00 PT -> Mon 06:00 PT for this roll. Exceptions via #release-requests with SRE + PM approval. Full notes: https://go.redwood/release-2024-05-rc :train:
release-bot: Deploy queued: service=edge-proxy, env=canary, tag=release-2024.05.0-rc1, canary=5% :white_check_mark:
raj: Quick heads-up: this includes a config change to default batching timeout (30ms -> 25ms). Should reduce tail latency but may affect tiny-request workloads.
nana: Typo: it's ana, not nana. :grin:
nana: sorry, meant ana :)
nana: We'll need to communicate the batching tweak to Platform teams and Private customers using default configs. Backcompat flag `RW_BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS` available.
infra-bot: Monitoring: small tail latency blip in ap-southeast-1 at 04:14 UTC. Stacktrace points to one outdated node draining unexpectedly.
sre: Investigating the drain; looks like kernel oom_kill on one pod due to memory spike. Noting for watch window.
raj: For Dedicated customers with pinned runtime, no behavior changes expected unless they toggle the env var. Private: please plan agent 2.10.2 to pick up the new default binary. Upgrade notes: https://go.redwood/agent-2-10-2
release-bot: Canary progress: edge-proxy 5% -> 20% (2024-05-09T04:40Z). No error spike flagged.
pm: PM note: owners, run the lightweight smoke checklist before we reach 50% (link: https://go.redwood/smoke-light). Confirm in-thread.
nana: Ana here 111. Smoke passed for api-gateway and embeddings pipeline. :thumbsup:
raj: Observed memory on one canary pod climb to 78% but stable. Monitoring for 10m.
sre: We'll abort ramp if memory >90% for any pod for 5m or error delta >1.5% for 10m.
infra-bot: Canary progress: edge-proxy 20% -> 50% (2024-05-09T05:10Z). Latency within SLOs.
release-bot: Pause at 50% for 20m watch window per SRE request. Owners please confirm smoke run complete.
nana: Confirm smoke run passed for Private staging. Writing advisory email draft now.
pm: Confirmed smoke for UI flows and integrations. :white_check_mark:
release-bot: Canary progress: edge-proxy 50% -> 85% (2024-05-09T05:45Z). No regressions detected.
sre: The earlier ap-southeast drain correlates with a transient kernel OOM on an old kernel image; infra will cordon similar nodes for the next 24h.
raj: We'll continue to watch CPU/mem on p4 nodes. If the memory pattern repeats, we'll throttle ramp and roll back.
release-bot: Canary -> 100% (2024-05-09T06:07Z). Post-deploy validations starting.
infra-bot: Post-deploy healthcheck: `curl -s https://api.redwood.dev/health | jq .` -> {"ok":true,"version":"release-2024.05.0-rc1"} on proxy layer.
nana: Sent Private customer advisory and agent 2.10.2 repo link.
pm: Final reminder: freeze active Thu 20:00 PT -> Mon 06:00 PT. Emergencies only via #release-requests. Thanks all 1
emma: Train complete. I'll update the release board and close the rollout ticket. Great job team :tada:
